Title: Public preview: ARM64 agent node support in AKS

Body.Content:
With the release of ARM64 agent node support in AKS, you can now create ARM64 Ubuntu agent nodes as well as mix Intel and ARM architecture nodes within a cluster. You can reduce the cost of running Kubernetes workloads and choose CPU/Memory configuration in addition to architecture.

Learn more.
